subject.title: fix(macos): reject revoked forwarded exec approvals

question: Should this PR absorb the Gateway node-session snapshot path before merge, or may that security boundary be deferred to a separate immediate dependent change?
rationale: The patch protects one Mac execution transport while another transport appears to retain the same stale-authority behavior; deciding the landing boundary and dependency ordering requires explicit security-owner intent.

options.title: Fix both transports here
options.body: Extend the approved-plan snapshot through GatewayNodeSession into MacNodeRuntime and validate it before landing this stack.

options.title: Require an immediate dependent PR
options.body: Keep this PR blocked until a separate proof-positive PR owns and fixes the node-session path with coordinated landing order.

options.title: Accept partial hardening
options.body: Land socket-only protection while explicitly owning that the alternate forwarded path remains exposed to the reported race.

recommendation.title: Fix both transports here
recommendation.body: Extend the approved-plan snapshot through GatewayNodeSession into MacNodeRuntime and validate it before landing this stack.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current authorization owner paths and authored both stacked changes, giving them the strongest context for the security and landing-boundary decision.
